title: PRODIGE 98- AMPIRINOX : Randomized, multicenter, Phase III trial of adjuvant chemotherapy with modified FOLFIRINOX versus capecitabine or gemcitabine in patients with resected ampullary adenocarcinoma.
official: PRODIGE 98- AMPIRINOX : Randomized, multicenter, Phase III trial of adjuvant chemotherapy with modified FOLFIRINOX versus capecitabine or gemcitabine in patients with resected ampullary adenocarcinoma.
summary: Main objective: To assess efficacy of adjuvant mFOLFIRINOX versus single-agent chemotherapy (gemcitabine or capecitabine) in improving 2-year disease-free survival (DFS) after surgical resection of an ampullary adenocarcinoma
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Histologically proven adenocarcinoma on surgical specimen
2. Women of childbearing age and men who are sexually active with women of childbearing age must agree to use highly effective contraception during the trial treatment and after stopping treatment: as a precaution, it is recommended that women of childbearing age continue to use contraception for 15 months after stopping treatment, and that men continue to use contraception for 12 months after stopping treatment
3. Patient affiliated to a social security scheme for France, or equivalents in European countries
4. Macroscopically complete surgical resection of an ampullary adenocarcinoma (R0 or R1)
5. Adenocarcinoma removed within 12 weeks prior to enrollment
6. Patient without metastatic disease on CT scan within the 4 weeks prior to inclusion
7. CA19.9 level < 180 UI/mL at inclusion (post-operative level)
8. Patients ≥ 18 years of age
9. WHO performance status 0 or 1 (WHO 0 if age >75)
10. Normal values of kalemia, magnesemia and calcemia
11. Patient able to understand and sign the information and informed consent note
Exclusion criteria:
1. Neoadjuvant systemic chemotherapy
2. Neutrophils < 1500/mm3, platelets < 150 000/mm3, Haemoglobin < 9 g/dL
3. Total bilirubin > 1.5x UNL (upper normal limit)
4. Creatinine clearance < 50 ml/min according to MDRD
5. Active and/or potentially severe infection
6. Treatment with a strong cytochrome P450 inhibitor within 4 weeks prior to the administration of the protocol treatment (Treatment with Hypericum perforatum)
7. Patient under treatment by brivudine, or treated by brivudine within 4 weeks prior to beginning of study treatment
8. Concomitant use of St John’s Wort
9. QT/QTc interval longer than 450msec for men and longer than 470msec for women on the ECG
10. Hypersensitivity to any of the study products or their excipients
11. Administration of live vaccines within 28 days prior to randomization
12. AST or ALT > 2.5 x UNL, alkaline phosphatase > 2.5x UNL at least 15 days after resection
13. Other cancer treated within the last 5 years except adequately treated, in situ cervical carcinoma or basocellular/spinocellular carcinoma
14. Chronic bowel disease requiring specific treatment and/or intestinal obstruction
15. Pregnant or breastfeeding woman
16. Person under guardianship
17. Inability to undergo the medical follow-up of the trial for geographical, social or psychological reasons
18. Patients with poor nutritional status represented by albuminemia < 30.0g/L
19. History of myocardial infarction within the last 6 months, severe coronary artery disease or severe heart failure
20. pT1N0M0 tumors
21. Active infection by HBV, HCV or HIV
22. Known dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase deficiency (uracilemia ≥ 16 ng/mL)
23. Pre-existing peripheral neuropathy (grade ≥ 2)
24. Unresolved or uncontrolled concomitant medical conditions
